name: Anyon Fractional Statistics Constraint Canonical
description: Abelian anyon braiding angle constraint: θ = pπ/q; encodes via QF_LIA that fractional statistics requires rational multiples of π

pytorch.reason: not needed for rational angle constraints

z3.reason: Encodes rational braiding angle constraint θ = pπ/q via QF_LIA; proves all abelian anyons have integer p, q; forbids irrational angles

sympy.reason: Verifies Berry phase accumulation formula for braid group; proves q exchanges return phase exp(i*pπ)

semion_statistics.interpretation: Semion anyons with θ = π/2 (p=1, q=2) are admissible

fibonacci_anyon.interpretation: Fibonacci anyons with θ = 4π/5 (p=4, q=5) are admissible

berry_phase_accumulation.interpretation: Berry phase accumulation after q braids: exp(i*q*θ) = exp(i*pπ) = (-1)^p
berry_phase_accumulation.consistency_condition: Braid group closes after q exchanges

irrational_theta_forbidden.interpretation: Irrational braiding angles cannot be expressed as integer ratios p/q; QF_LIA forbids them

transcendental_angle_blocked.interpretation: Non-π transcendental angles (e.g., θ = e, θ = √2) cannot appear; all abelian anyons have θ = pπ/q

non_closure_impossible.interpretation: Braid group closure is automatic for rational θ = pπ/q; N exchanges give phase 2πNp/q

fermion_limit.interpretation: Fermions are boundary case: θ = π (p=1, q=1); sign flip under exchange

boson_limit.interpretation: Bosons are boundary case: θ = 0 (p=0, q=1); no sign flip under exchange

tqft_realizability.interpretation: Anyons with small denominator q are realizable in topological field theory; q=2,3,4,5 are physically realized
